role: independent verifier (own code under roles/verifier/code/; labels only via nrm.common.load, operation verify, logged)
rules: append-only: an entry is never edited or removed; each written version is snapshotted to records/history/ and the hashes of all earlier entries are re-checked before every write
numerical_status (own code recomputes a recorded number) and procedural_status (process, access, record evidence) are recorded separately; values PASS, FAIL, ATTENTION, NOT_APPLICABLE, NOT_RUN
an acceptance rule is never widened after a failure; a corrected check gets a new id and an entry in CHECK_CHANGES.json (before, after, cause, adjudication request); the earlier result is kept

checks.what: verifier library self-test on invented data (AUC, weighted AUC, clustered and subgroup SEs, household folds, losses, decisions, wire / array hashes, clause table and draw averaging, reserve edges, winner pick, bootstrap multiplicities, cache key, reader seeds)
